suggestion.topic: Cracking the System Design Interview: Distributed ID Generators
suggestion.rationale: System design interview preparation is a perpetual top search category. Providing an architectural breakdown of distributed unique ID generation (like Snowflake) drives immense replay value.
suggestion.hook_angle: If an interviewer asks you to design Twitter's ID generator for 10 million writes per second, auto-incrementing SQL IDs will instantly fail you.
